aiTrends.summary: For all the data that AI systems continually amass and analyze, enterprise AI agents often suffer from a curious shortcoming: a lack of knowledge. aiTrends.summary: A central challenge in de novo protein design is generating proteins with desired structural and functional properties. Existing design models typically require a dedicated input representation for each property, limiting the design objectives they support. aiTrends.summary: Clinical sleep medicine repeatedly documents profound divergences between objective sleep duration and subjective daytime impairment, notably exemplified by sleep state misperception in paradoxical insomnia and boundary instability in narcolepsy type 1. aiTrends.summary: Deep-space communications operate under intermittent connectivity, long propagation delays, and relay storage constraints. aiTrends.summary: Capability evaluations aim to surface dangerous model behaviors before deployment, but their reliability depends on the assumption that hidden capabilities can be elicited. aiTrends.summary: The expressivity of a neural network $Φ$ describes the class of functions that a network can express. The term topological expressivity refers to a family of measures particularly suited to understand binary classification and is often formulated in terms of the Betti numbers of a decision boundary $β(Φ^{-1}(0))$. aiTrends.title: Hide and Seek: HIDE Concepts to SEEK explanations for black box models
aiTrends.summary: Interpreting machine learning model predictions is a central challenge, particularly for black-box vision models. Concept-based attribution methods interpret models using human-understandable concepts. Existing concept-based methods can only interpret classification and regression models. aiTrends.title: Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game?
aiTrends.summary: Language models increasingly support or automate information retrieval from document collections too large to index. This task is difficult when it requires specialist linguistic or scientific knowledge. We used the Wikipedia Game to test language models on an analogous information retrieval task. aiTrends.title: DeepSeek-V3 and R1 Open Weights Challenge Frontier AI Paradigms
aiTrends.summary: DeepSeek released open-weights architecture with Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE, demonstrating competitive reasoning benchmarks at drastically reduced training cost.

aiTrends.title: Google DeepMind Unveils Gemini 2.0 and Flash Thinking Mode
aiTrends.summary: Google introduced Gemini 2.0 with native multimodal audio/video streaming, Flash Thinking experimental reasoning models, and expanded agentic execution via Google AI Studio.

aiTrends.title: Anthropic Expands Model Context Protocol (MCP) Open Standard
aiTrends.summary: Anthropic introduced the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard enabling developers to securely connect AI assistants to local file systems, database tables, and external APIs.
aiTrends.tags: MCP, Open Standard, Agents, Tool Use

aiTrends.title: OpenAI Introduces Operator and Computer-Using Agent Capabilities
aiTrends.summary: OpenAI deployed Operator research preview and canvas workspace features, allowing AI agents to interact with web interfaces, fill out forms, and automate complex workflows.

aiTrends.title: Meta Llama 3.3 70B Brings Flagship Performance to Scalable Open Inference
aiTrends.summary: Meta released Llama 3.3 70B under an open permissive license, matching earlier 405B capabilities while fitting on single dual-GPU workstations for enterprise fine-tuning.

aiTrends.title: Hugging Face smolagents Library Provides Lightweight Code Agents
aiTrends.summary: Hugging Face introduced smolagents, a minimalistic Python framework allowing LLMs to write Python code directly to execute tool steps rather than verbose JSON tool schemas.
aiTrends.tags: smolagents, Python, Code Agents, Tool Calling

aiTools.name: GitHub Copilot
aiTools.description: AI pair programmer powered by OpenAI and Anthropic models that offers code completions, whole-function synthesis, and contextual terminal assistance.
aiTools.use_cases: Python & TypeScript development, test generation, refactoring, CLI command synthesis
aiTools.pricing_details: $10/mo for individuals, free for verified students & open-source maintainers

aiTools.name: Cursor
aiTools.description: AI-first fork of VS Code built for multi-file code editing, repository-wide embeddings index, and autonomous agentic terminal execution.
aiTools.use_cases: Full-stack web apps, complex refactoring, codebase Q&A, automatic bug fixing
aiTools.pricing_details: Free tier with 2,000 completions; Pro at $20/month with unlimited Claude 3.5 Sonnet

aiTools.name: Hugging Face Hub
aiTools.description: The open platform for machine learning models, datasets, and demonstration apps (Spaces). Host, evaluate, and fine-tune open weights.
aiTools.use_cases: Model discovery (Llama, Mistral, Whisper), dataset hosting, GGUF quantized models, demo deployment
aiTools.pricing_details: Free public repos, community inference API; Pro tier $9/mo for accelerated GPU quota

aiTools.name: Google AI Studio
aiTools.description: Fast prototyping environment for Gemini 2.5 and multimodal models with generous free rate limits, structured prompts, and code export.
aiTools.use_cases: Prompt engineering, function calling, audio/video analysis, free API prototyping
aiTools.pricing_details: Free tier with high RPM for Gemini models; Pay-as-you-go for high-volume enterprise

aiTools.name: Claude Artifacts & Projects
aiTools.description: Anthropic's reasoning model interface with interactive code sandboxes, frontend previews, and shared team knowledge bases.
aiTools.use_cases: Complex algorithmic reasoning, paper synthesis, architecture design, interactive UI prototyping
aiTools.pricing_details: Free access with standard quotas; Pro at $20/month with 5x usage and Claude 3.5 Sonnet

aiTools.name: vLLM
aiTools.description: High-throughput, memory-efficient LLM serving engine featuring PagedAttention and continuous batching for production inference.
aiTools.use_cases: Self-hosted model serving, GPU memory optimization, OpenAI-compatible local APIs

aiTools.name: Perplexity AI
aiTools.description: AI conversational search engine providing grounded research answers with direct academic and web citations.
aiTools.use_cases: Academic paper lookups, competitor market research, factual code documentation exploration
aiTools.pricing_details: Free unlimited Quick search; Pro at $20/month with Claude 3.5 Sonnet & GPT-4o deep search

aiTools.name: Gamma App
aiTools.description: AI generative presentation and document builder that transforms outlines or text notes into polished slides, webpages, and briefings.
aiTools.use_cases: Technical presentation decks, thesis defenses, product pitch briefs, executive summaries
aiTools.pricing_details: Free 400 initial credits; Plus at $8/month and Pro at $15/month for unlimited generation

aiTools.name: Ollama
aiTools.description: Get up and running with large language models locally on macOS, Linux, and Windows with simple CLI commands.
aiTools.use_cases: Offline local model inference (Llama 3.3, DeepSeek, Qwen), private data processing

aiTools.name: LangChain & LangGraph
aiTools.description: Framework for building stateful, multi-actor agentic applications and cyclical workflow graphs with LLMs.
aiTools.use_cases: Agent architectures, tool calling loops, multi-agent collaboration, memory retention
aiTools.pricing_details: Core framework is free open-source; LangSmith tracing includes a free developer tier
